exports.n: CEPII BACI HS92 natural gas in gaseous state (HS 271121, pipeline), 2024, all transport modes, gross weight; world = sum of all reported flows in the Atlas BACI extract (flows below 1,000 t and 1 M USD omitted) · Pipeline-gas tonnage in customs data is often estimated from value and is far too low for North America: customs data show 12.2 Mt of Canadian exports in 2024, EIA 88.6 bcm. Use the EIA production and consumption tables (bcm) for volumes.
exports.caveat: Pipeline-gas tonnage in customs data is often estimated from value and is far too low for North America: customs data show 12.2 Mt of Canadian exports in 2024, EIA 88.6 bcm. Use the EIA production and consumption tables (bcm) for volumes.

imports.n: CEPII BACI HS92 natural gas in gaseous state (HS 271121, pipeline), 2024, all transport modes, gross weight; world = sum of all reported flows in the Atlas BACI extract (flows below 1,000 t and 1 M USD omitted) · Pipeline-gas tonnage in customs data is often estimated from value and is far too low for North America (see the exporters table).
imports.caveat: Pipeline-gas tonnage in customs data is often estimated from value and is far too low for North America (see the exporters table).

notes: Trade tables cover gas in gaseous state (HS 271121: pipeline) in Mt; LNG is under 'lng'. Flows are shown as pipeline mode.
No proved-reserves series exists in the EIA bulk file used (INTL.txt).
Customs tonnage for pipeline gas is unreliable for North America, where it is estimated from value; use EIA bcm figures for production and consumption.
